jobs.description: We are the UK s leading premium publisher, home to iconic and influential media brands including Esquire, Men s & Women s Health, ELLE, Good Housekeeping, Harper s Bazaar, Digital Spy, Cosmopolitan, Red and more. At Hearst UK, we don t just create content – we shape culture. Our workplace is driven by passion, shaped by authenticity and powered by creativity. We back bold ideas, act with an entrepreneurial mindset and continually evolve to meet the moment – while respecting the legacy that s brought us here. We believe in each other s potential and push boundaries together to create meaningful impact, both across the media landscape and in people s lives. We re proud of our heritage – but even more excited about making history. Hearst UK operates an in-office policy with flexible Fridays. Our office is based at House of Hearst, 30 Panton Street, St James s, London, SW1Y 4AJ , where teams collaborate in person and connect across brands and functions. Salary – Circa £30,000 Salary is dependent on experience and will be assessed in line with the candidate s skills, knowledge and relevant expertise. The Role... You will also assist and, when necessary, deputise for, the Chief sub-editors in overseeing the subbing and production process, from copy stage through to sending pages to press. Main Duties... Subbing raw copy (checking facts, spelling and grammar) and fitting layouts for all pages of Country Living , ELLE , ELLE Decoration , Esquire , Harper’s Bazaar and House Beautiful magazines, along with any additional editorial or commercial content that arises during the production cycle. jobs.title: Copywriter
jobs.description: As a Copywriter (m/w/d), you will own the words behind PERGOLUX campaigns across our global markets, writing and editing copy for Meta, Google, email, and web that turns product benefits into clear, persuasive messaging. You will shape headlines, product descriptions, campaign concepts, and calls to action, adapting tone and messaging for different audiences, languages, and cultural contexts while keeping brand voice consistent. Working closely with marketing, product, e-commerce, and sales colleagues, you will drive copy quality from first draft through hands-on editing and testing. PERGOLUX designs and sells Scandinavian-inspired outdoor living products, from pergolas to garden furniture, directly to consumers. We are a company that has grown consistently across Europe and beyond, with around 300 employees, 9-figure revenue, and operations spanning 8 markets. Van indrukwekkende staalbewerkingsmachines en nieuwe technologieën tot de mensen en verhalen achter onze internationale organisatie. Als stagiair Content Creation ga jij die verhalen zichtbaar maken. jobs.description: QUI SOMMES-NOUS ? Premier groupe public de grandes écoles d’ingénieurs et de management en France, l’Institut Mines-Télécom (IMT) est un acteur majeur de l’enseignement supérieur, de la recherche et de l’innovation au service du développement économique, industriel et technologique de la France. Héritier de plus de deux siècles d’histoire scientifique, technologique et industrielle, il fédère huit grandes écoles publiques — IMT Atlantique, IMT Mines Albi, IMT Mines Alès, IMT Nord Europe, Institut Mines-Télécom Business School, Mines Saint-Étienne, Télécom Paris et Télécom SudParis — et deux écoles filiales, EURECOM et InSIC. Avec près de 5 000 personnels, 150 laboratoires, 500 partenaires académiques dans 70 pays et des milliers d’entreprises partenaires, l’IMT forme près de 15 000 élèves-ingénieurs, managers et docteurs et développe une recherche de pointe qui irrigue ses formations et nourrit l’innovation. Ancré au cœur des territoires, l’IMT fait de chaque école une porte d’entrée régionale vers son offre de formation, sa puissance scientifique et ses plateformes technologiques. L’IMT articule formation, recherche et transfert d’innovation autour de quatre thématiques stratégiques — Industrie du futur responsable, Souveraineté et sobriété numérique, Énergie économie circulaire et société, Ingénierie de la santé et du bien-être — afin d’accompagner les transformations des entreprises et des filières et de contribuer aux grandes transitions, à la reconquête industrielle et à la souveraineté technologique de la France et de l’Europe. jobs.description: Not all heroes wear capes – but plenty of them use toilet paper Want to challenge yourself at a purpose-led scale up AND make a difference in the world? Come join the revolootion! As of June 2026, we've contributed over $20 million AUD to this mission. Basically, we're really good at making it easy to do good. We operate scaling businesses in the UK, US, Australia and Canada. Our 250+ people aim to make the biggest possible impact for people and the planet. This is a role for someone who loves writing, is curious about what makes an ad actually work and wants to get hands-on with briefs that are driven by real performance data. You'll be writing scripts and copy for paid social (still and video), collaborating with our local creative strategists and video team, and doing the kind of fast-paced, purposeful work that puts more planet-conscious toilet paper in the world.
